description: Read-only Open Library recipes for book search, ISBN edition lookup, author works, work metadata, bounded editions, and subject browsing with source/rate-limit caveats.

novel_features.name: Compact book/work search
novel_features.description: Searches Open Library's preferred search endpoint and returns compact ranked work candidates with author, edition, ISBN, language, and source URL fields.

novel_features.name: ISBN edition resolver
novel_features.description: Resolves ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 values to edition metadata without account actions or borrowing flows.

novel_features.name: Author works sampler
novel_features.description: Searches author records or accepts an Open Library author ID, then fetches a bounded works sample for bibliography-building agents.

novel_features.name: Work and editions metadata
novel_features.description: Fetches canonical work JSON and bounded edition lists from documented Open Library work APIs.

novel_features.name: Subject discovery with caveats
novel_features.description: Fetches subject works and optional facets while clearly marking the Subjects API as experimental.

novel_features.name: Source/rate posture
novel_features.description: Reports keyless auth, optional contact-bearing User-Agent configuration, documented rate limits, and anti-bulk non-goals.
